$$

At the requested entry, this gives

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}S &=\begin{bmatrix}7 & -4 & -8 \\ -3 & -4 & 3 \\ -3 & 7 & -9\end{bmatrix}\qquad {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-{R}_{2} \\ &\sim \begin{bmatrix}7 & -4 & -8 \\ -3 & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & 11 & -12\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-{R}_{2}.
